metas.name: #Love
metas.description: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

metas.name: 56 Days
metas.description: When an unidentified body is found in a luxury apartment linked to Oliver Kennedy and his girlfriend Ciara Wyse, Detectives Lee Reardon and Karl Connolly reconstruct the couple's deadly romance across the past 56 days.

metas.name: A Couple of Lies
metas.description: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.

metas.name: A Different World
metas.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

metas.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms The Hedge Knight
metas.description: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.

metas.name: A Love So Beautiful (Areumdawossdeon Wooriegye)
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: A Tale of Two Cities
metas.description: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

metas.name: Ab Hoga Hisaab
metas.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

metas.name: Absolute Value of Romance
metas.description: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

metas.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: Agatha Christies Seven Dials
metas.description: England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

metas.name: Agent from Above
metas.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

metas.name: Amar Vishwas
metas.description: Amar Vishwas is a gripping legal drama about a fearless lawyer who believes that the law has value only when it protects the truly innocent. Shaped by a painful past, Amar has built his life around one unbreakable principal - if a person is innocent in reality, justice must be delivered, even if it means crossing boundries.

metas.name: American Hostage
metas.description: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

metas.name: Atonko
metas.description: Accusing his uncle of abuse shatters Purba's life. Is she exposing a predator?

metas.name: Avatar Seven Havens
metas.description: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

metas.name: Balaraw Blood Island (Balaraw)
metas.description: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

metas.name: Bandi
metas.description: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

metas.name: Bandwaale
metas.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

metas.name: Bass x Machina
metas.description: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

metas.name: Bb Bakshi
metas.description: A sharp-witted female constable named Bibi from the quiet town of Golappur uses her keen intuition and unique problem-solving skills to crack local mysterious cases. While navigating the challenges of her profession, she also manages her personal life and a budding romance with Gopal.

metas.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
metas.description: Follow Gordon Ramsay over 9 months in the lead up to his biggest restaurant venture to date: the opening of 5 culinary experiences in London's 22 Bishopsgate, the City of London's tallest building.

metas.name: Believe Me
metas.description: The horrific true story of John Worboys, one of the most notorious serial rapists in British history. His modus operandi was to tell women in his cab that he’d won some money and then persistently offer them a glass of champagne, which he’d laced with drugs, and which rendered his victims unconscious. He was convicted in 2009 for sexually assaulting 12 women between 2006 and 2008, with their cases selected from a large number of suspected further victims.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

metas.name: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
metas.description: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

metas.name: Big Mistakes
metas.description: Blackmailed into working for some very dangerous people, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

metas.name: Boyfriend on Demand
metas.description: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings — and maybe a real shot at romance.

metas.name: Brothers
metas.description: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

metas.name: Brown
metas.description: Brown is a recovering alcoholic, who works for Kolkata Police and has to investigate the murder of a young woman from a well-known family.

metas.name: Byomkesh Bakshi
metas.description: Byomkesh Bakshi, a truth-seeking detective, tries to solve complex cases with his sidekick, Ajit Kumar Banerjee.

metas.name: Can This Love Be Translated
metas.description: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

metas.name: Cash Queens
metas.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

metas.name: Chaar Yaar
metas.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

metas.name: Chainsmoker Cat
metas.description: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones' concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

metas.name: Chiraiya
metas.description: Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

metas.name: Choddobeshi
metas.description: Brocke detective Aditya Majumder is struggling to save both his career and his failing marrage when he's hired to project legendary action Mandakini, who services a series of deadly "accidents." As he digs deeper, buried family secretes, grayed and tetrayal turn every hair into a facet.

metas.name: Chumbak
metas.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

metas.name: Clean Up Company
metas.description: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

metas.name: Crap Happens
metas.description: Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.

metas.name: Crew Girl
metas.description: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

metas.name: Daldal
metas.description: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

metas.name: Dead End Job
metas.description: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

metas.name: Debi
metas.description: When an aspiring actress is murdered, an underestimated police constable uncovers a chilling conspiracy between a revered god-man and a grieving mother, only to realize the mastermind is hiding under her own roof.

metas.name: Debipokkho
metas.description: Ishani returns to the Sheel mansion when a sacred golden tongue goes missing, only to be blamed for the theft. As another shocking secret comes to light, she finds herself trapped among a family full of hidden motives. Two wills and a sinister riddle could change her fate forever.

metas.name: Delusion
metas.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

metas.name: Detective Hole
metas.description: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me
metas.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

metas.name: Doctor X Age of the White Mafia (DakteoX hayan mapiaui sidae)
metas.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

metas.name: Dog Park
metas.description: In the grip of a mid-life crisis, Roland meets the eternal optimist Samantha and her life-loving group of dog-parkers. As Roland begrudgingly keeps returning to the park, he realises he might need a community to belong to.

metas.name: DTF St Louis
metas.description: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

metas.name: Elite Force
metas.description: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

metas.name: Exam
metas.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

metas.name: Eyes
metas.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

metas.name: Fading Grandeur
metas.description: Desperate to sell his crumbling mansion, a fallen marquis tries to make a quick deal with a charming yet mysterious millionaire who has her own agenda.

metas.name: Felu Mitter Lane
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Free Bert
metas.description: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby crowd at their elite new school.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: Girl Taken
metas.description: Follow the story of twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes - only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges.

metas.name: Glitter and Gold Ice Dancing
metas.description: Folder: English

metas.name: Glory
metas.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

metas.name: Gold land
metas.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

metas.name: Golden Axe
metas.description: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

metas.name: Gorki R Ma
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Habeas Corpus
metas.description: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

metas.name: Half Man
metas.description: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

metas.name: Hello Bachhon
metas.description: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning.

metas.name: His & Hers
metas.description: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Class is in session at Hollywood Arts! Self-proclaimed icon Trina Vega returns to steer gifted teens toward stardom, status and hilarious havoc.

metas.name: Honeymoon Se Hatya
metas.description: A five-part true-crime docudrama uncovers real cases where wives kill their husbands. The series dives deep into how love, control, betrayal and hidden marital fractures can lead to fatal breakdowns

metas.name: How To Get To Heaven From Belfast
metas.description: Three lifelong pals embark on a chaotic quest to solve the mystery of their old friend's suspicious death and keep their own dark secret under wraps.

metas.name: How to Ruin Diwali
metas.description: When overachieving perfectionist Mmabatho Nkomo meets her fiancé’s traditional Indian family for the first time, her desperate attempt to make a good impression goes badly wrong. She accidentally exposes her future father-in-law’s secret affair. With Diwali only days away, Mmabatho must navigate unfamiliar cultural territory and try to reunite the family she has torn apart — without creating even more chaos.

metas.name: Human Vapor
metas.description: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

metas.name: Hunkkaar The Roar
metas.description: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

metas.name: I Will Find You
metas.description: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

metas.name: I Would Rather Die
metas.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

metas.name: If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

metas.name: Inside the Circle (El circulo)
metas.description: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

metas.name: It Gets Worse
metas.description: Three best friends from college face eviction in London. As they scatter across the city, they navigate friendship, dating disasters, and adulting - all while the world crumbles around them.

metas.name: Its Not Like That
metas.description: Freshly divorced Lori and recently widowed minister Malcolm, friends with teens, navigate singlehood while questioning if their longstanding bond hints at a romantic future.

metas.name: Jazz City
metas.description: Set in 1971 Calcutta, a jazz club becomes the backdrop for a revolutionary awakening as music intertwines with language, identity and the birth of a nation during a pivotal historical moment.

metas.name: Kaakee Circus
metas.description: A small town in Tamil Nadu wakes up to chaos when a temple donation box is stolen from the sub-jail. Soon, the investigation led by two eccentric policemen unravels secrets more than they can handle.

metas.name: Kaalipotka
metas.description: In a gritty urban jungle, four women - Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti - are drawn into chaos after Minoti's husband's freak accident. A cover-up spirals into deceit, murder, and revenge as ex-con Rana and the police hunt them

metas.name: Kaptaan
metas.description: SSP Samardeep, a feared encounter specialist, hides a broken past behind his ruthless image. Years ago, in his pursuit of revenge, he abandoned his informant DK’s brothers. Now In Jwalabad, as Munna, Tinnu, and Shaheen battle for a ₹180-crore tender, Samar joins forces with the ruthless Kabir—only to discover he is one of those lost children, forcing him to face his past.

metas.name: Kasargod Embassy
metas.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

metas.name: Katakuti 2
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Kauriburir Mandir
metas.description: When a mysterious curse threatens the woman he once loved, astrologer Bhabataran enters a haunted wilderness where an ancient cult worships a bloodthirsty deity. As a forbidden ritual draws near, he must confront a terrifying legacy buried for centuries.

metas.name: Khanikta Premer Moto
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: La Oficina
metas.description: Regional manager Jerónimo Ponce III leads the Aguascalientes branch of the family-run Jabones Olimpo, where the employees have to endure the headaches of working for a family business where the boss is not qualified to lead the company.

metas.name: Land of Sin
metas.description: When a teenager goes missing, a detective with personal ties to the case joins a tense investigation that reveals fierce loyalties and old family feuds.

metas.name: Lanterns
metas.description: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

metas.name: Legends
metas.description: As drugs flood the streets of '90s Britain, a team of civil servants is thrust undercover to topple the gangs behind it.

metas.name: Lingam
metas.description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.
